verdict.rationale: Firebase Security Rules are documented as the mechanism to define what data your users can access across Cloud Firestore, Realtime Database, and Cloud Storage, at whatever granularity the app needs. Community hands-on reports back up the access-policy layer, praising how it separates data logic from enforcement, though some find the rules language a pain point. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of per-user, identity-based rule conditions (e.g., tying rules to the authenticated user ID), and documentation of testing or deploying rules.
